facts.text: Compliance, risk, security, fraud, prohibited strategy, and platform-integrity updates may apply immediately to existing accounts where Finotive considers this necessary.

Prohibited Behaviour covers conduct that is abusive, non-reproducible, manipulative, deceptive, non-compliant, or otherwise prohibited, and may lead to payout delay, payout rejection or account closure after Risk or Compliance review.
